summary: A notes app with email and password login; each user's notes are private, enforced by row level security
assumptions: Notes are plain text up to 2000 characters

ui_elements.label: Sign up
ui_elements.purpose: Creates an account and logs in

ui_elements.label: Log in
ui_elements.purpose: Logs in to an existing account

ui_elements.label: New note
ui_elements.purpose: Text of the note to add

ui_elements.label: Your notes
ui_elements.purpose: The logged in user's notes, newest first

features.name: Sign up and log in
features.description: Email and password forms; signing up logs the user in at once

acceptance_criteria.statement: A new user signs up and sees the notes screen with a Log out button

features.name: Write notes
features.description: Add a note and see it in the list, kept after a reload

acceptance_criteria.statement: An added note appears in Your notes and is still there after a reload

features.name: Private notes
features.description: Each user only ever sees their own notes

acceptance_criteria.statement: A second user does not see the first user's notes

tables.name: notes
access_rules: Owners can read, add, change and delete their own notes
Nobody else can see or change them

risks.risk: A user seeing another user's notes
risks.mitigation: Row level security on user_id = auth.uid()

files.purpose: The notes table and its owner only rules

visual_design: A calm, plain page: a centred login card, then a single column of notes.
